## Source review

- Names, comments and formatting checked against the surrounding code.
- Unnecessary helpers, duplication and unrelated edits removed.
- Game-format, patch-byte and project-file compatibility considered where relevant.
- Public descriptions checked against verified behavior; any new artwork has documented source and redistribution terms.
